description: Avtobusna postajališča v občini Tržič is a dataset listed in Slovenia’s open data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by OBČINA TRŽIČ. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-odprti-podatki-slovenije.
